Friendly Lines is an app for supporting the development of fine motor skills in children.\n\nFirst, prepare the patterns needed for learning in the Pattern Gallery. Then create Learning Steps — exercise sets in which you select materials (patterns) from the previously created list and configure how they will be used. Use the buttons below to manage the patterns or learning steps used during sessions with the child.
Opens the patterns gallery, where you can browse and add patterns used for teaching.
Opens the list of learning steps - configurable exercise sets combining patterns, settings, and a test for the child.

Here you can browse patterns.

To create your own pattern, click the first item on the list below.

Patterns can also be deleted (by clicking the trash icon in the top-right corner of the pattern). Only your own patterns can be deleted, exemplary patterns are permanent and cannot be deleted.
Click here to start creating a completely new learning step.
Starts a session using the currently active learning step (highlighted in green) in the selected mode (learning/test).
When enabled, the example learning steps included with the app are hidden - only steps created by you are visible.
The list of learning steps below. Check a row\'s checkbox to set it as the active step used when you press “RUN”.
Switches a step between Learning mode (with hints and reinforcements) and Test mode (no assistance).
Use these actions to edit, copy, or delete a learning step. Deletion and editing are unavailable for exemplary steps.

Learning steps are exercise sets prepared using previously added educational materials.\n\nHere you can manage learning steps: create new ones, edit, copy, or delete existing ones, switch between modes (learning/test), and start a session with the child for the currently selected step (highlighted in green).
The active learning step doesn\'t have enough patterns configured for the selected mode. Add materials to be able to run it.
Adds another pattern to this learning step, for which you can configure properties that will be used during the game.
Use these actions to edit, copy, or delete a learning step. You can also use the arrows to move the pattern up/down the list and change the order in which patterns are displayed during the game.
No patterns have been added to this learning step yet. To do so, tap the \'ADD PATTERN\' button
When enabled, the example patterns included with the app are hidden - only patterns created by you are visible.
Add patterns that will be used in this learning step.
Configure how each trial looks and proceeds during learning and what assistance the child receives.
Choose the verbal, visual, and end-of-session reinforcements that will help the child retain what they\'ve learned.
Configure the test settings for the child — by default the same as learning, but you can change them here.
Review the summary of the configured learning step, give it a name, and save it.
Controls how each trial is presented to the child: the number of repetitions for each patters, the number of attempts for each pattern, time limit and random pattern order.
Controls the assistance given during learning: accuracy level and starting point.
Select a pattern from the list below to configure its properties that will be used during the game.
Configure pattern properities: pattern thickness, pattern color, drawing color, background color and pattern variety. These properties will be used do display pattern during the game.
Enable this to use different settings for the test than for learning. When disabled, the test reuses the settings shown on the Learning tab.
To change these settings, check the checkbox at the top of the screen. Otherwise, the test will use the same settings as learning.
In TEST mode random pattern order is turned off. During the game, patterns will be shown in order determined by their position on the list in PATTERNS tab.
In test mode, hints (starting point) and reinforcements are not used and the therapist does not help or talk to the child until the test is finished.
